# Experiment 2: cost model and power (generated by scripts/s2_e2_budget.py)

No money is spent by this script. Unit costs are those Experiment 1 was billed at; the scenarios bracket what is not yet measured.

## Assumptions, and the gate that checks each

| assumption | value | checked at |
|---|---|---|
| a sampled practice attempt costs this many greedy `test_id` episodes | 1.25 | Stage 1 yield probe |
| engine speed-up over Experiment 1 | 1x, 4x or 10x | Stage 1 calibration |
| yield (accepted tasks per attempted task) | 20%, 40% or 60% | Stage 1 probe, Stage 2 pilot |
| job overhead; contingency for failed jobs | x1.1; x1.25 | ledger, every stage |
| teacher: acceptance, attempts per task | 60%, 1.5 | Stage 1 qualification |
| teacher: cost per attempt | 0.0009 to 0.004 USD | Stage 1 qualification |

## Power on `test_comp` (600 families, two tasks each)

Measured on the 1.5B student in Experiment 1: standard deviation of replicate means 0.022 at 25 families and 0.015 at 1,600, from three replicates each (a 95% interval for a standard deviation estimated from three values runs from about half to six times the estimate). Per-family standard deviation of the observed difference between those two arms, replicate and task noise included: 0.300, used as an upper bound for arms that differ less.

| seed sd | replicates per arm | SE of an arm difference (points) | difference detected with 80% power | non-inferiority at 7.5 points has 80% power |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0.02 | 5 | 1.8 | 5.6 | yes |
| 0.02 | 8 | 1.6 | 4.8 | yes |
| 0.03 | 5 | 2.3 | 7.2 | yes |
| 0.03 | 8 | 1.9 | 5.8 | yes |
| 0.05 | 5 | 3.4 | 10.8 | no |
| 0.05 | 8 | 2.8 | 8.4 | yes |

Two-sided 5% tests with Student-t quantiles on 2(n - 1) degrees of freedom; one-sided 5% for non-inferiority at a true difference of zero.
